column2: الذكاء الاصطناعي التعليم مصر 2026 منصة مفتوحة المصدر
column3: 🟢 NON-NIL — the LAST unspent directed leg, and the national language was again the channel
column4: Egypt's Ministry of Communications and IT launched, early 2026, a domestic large language model "كرنك" (Karnak) AND a secondary-school AI teacher "سيا" (Sia). Officials place Karnak inside public digital infrastructure explicitly so startups can build applications on top. Separately "مدرستك في مصر" (Madrasatak fi Masr), a MoE + MoFA platform offering interactive classes aligned to the Egyptian curriculum; the Ministry frames the state platform as COMPLEMENTARY to classroom teaching, not a replacement. 🔴 NO LICENCE STATED for Karnak or Sia, no GitHub org, no repository, no code. 🔵 THIRD proof after Vietnam (p290) and Mexico (p291) that the national language is the channel for POLICY and names — and the third time it yields no code. The pattern is now strong enough to state as a finding rather than a hope.
